people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
translations.bsb: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue Joseph from their hands. “Let us not take his life,” he said.
